priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.title: Preallocate PriorityQueue capacity
priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.summary: Use EnsureCapacity when the number of queued items is predictable.
priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.details: Preallocating before a large insertion phase can reduce backing-array growth while avoiding unnecessarily huge capacities.

random-getitems.title: Sample items from a candidate set with Random.GetItems
random-getitems.summary: Select a requested number of random elements from a candidate span.
random-getitems.details: Express sampling with replacement directly instead of maintaining index arithmetic by hand, and distinguish it from shuffling or unique sampling.

dateonly-tryformat.title: Format DateOnly directly into a Span
dateonly-tryformat.summary: TryFormat writes a date into an existing character buffer.
dateonly-tryformat.details: For fixed-format output, avoid an intermediate string and handle both the success result and number of characters written.

randomaccess-getlength.title: Get file length with RandomAccess
randomaccess-getlength.summary: Read the current file length directly from a SafeFileHandle.
randomaccess-getlength.details: Keep length queries with RandomAccess operations without creating a position-sharing Stream around the handle.

jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.title: Check JsonSerializer reflection defaults
jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.summary: Branch configuration based on whether reflection serialization is enabled by default.
jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.details: IsReflectionEnabledByDefault helps AOT-friendly code choose source-generated metadata instead of accidentally depending on reflection.

bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.title: Round an integer up to a power of two
bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.summary: Use BitOperations.RoundUpToPowerOf2 for explicit capacity calculations.
bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.details: For buffers and tables that require power-of-two capacities, prefer the standard operation over handwritten bit tricks and account for its boundary behavior.

channelreader-readallasync.title: Consume a ChannelReader with await foreach
channelreader-readallasync.summary: ReadAllAsync expresses consumption until channel completion as an async sequence.
channelreader-readallasync.details: Pass cancellation and process each item without manually maintaining a WaitToReadAsync and TryRead loop.

operating-system-version-check.title: Check an operating system and minimum version together
operating-system-version-check.summary: Use OperatingSystem VersionAtLeast helpers for platform feature gates.
operating-system-version-check.details: Avoid parsing OS version strings and express both the platform and required minimum version directly in code.

string-create-spanstate.title: Build strings directly with string.Create
string-create-spanstate.summary: Write into the final string storage and avoid intermediate buffers.
string-create-spanstate.details: When the final length is known, pass state into a Span<char> callback and fill every character of the result.

memoryextensions-count-span.title: Count value occurrences in a Span
memoryextensions-count-span.summary: MemoryExtensions.Count directly counts matching values in span-based data.
memoryextensions-count-span.details: For simple character or byte frequencies, express the operation directly instead of introducing a manual loop or LINQ enumeration.
